notes: Watched against OpenCode 1.19.6 in tmux on 2026-11-23: a permission for a folder outside the project and one for a shell command, a turn running and the prompt after it; the screens are `testdata/screens/opencode-*`. That release titles the terminal only `OpenCode`, so the screen's footer carries the state; the older `OC |` title with a spinner is kept for the releases that set it.

rules.note: Older releases put one spinner glyph before their `OC |` title while a turn runs; nothing typed into the composer reaches the title.
`△ Permission required` over `Allow once   Allow always   Reject`, for a shell command and for a folder outside the project alike.
The footer reads `esc interrupt` beside its progress bar only while a turn runs; a permission replaces the footer, and outranks this anyway.
The idle footer (`tab agents  ctrl+p commands`) with no `esc interrupt` in it. No word boundary before `ctrl`: a long folder path wraps the footer to `tab agentsctrl+p`.
